input.query:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_xaed8f.ticket_themes AS
SELECT word AS theme,
       count(distinct ticket_id) AS ticket_count,
       min(ticket_id) AS example_ticket_id
FROM (
   SELECT ticket_id,
          explode(split(lower(regexp_replace(subject, '[^a-zA-Z0-9 ]', '')), ' ')) AS word
   FROM workspace.exam_xaed8f.tickets
) t
WHERE word NOT IN ('for','my','the','is','to','and','a','of','in','i','you','it','on','with','after','has','been','was','are','be','this','that')
  AND length(word) > 2
GROUP BY word
ORDER BY ticket_count DESC, theme
LIMIT 3;
SELECT * FROM workspace.exam_xaed8f.ticket_themes ORDER BY ticket_count DESC, theme
SELECT ticket_id, lower(split(regexp_replace(subject, '[^a-zA-Z0-9 ]', ''), ' ')[0]) as first_word FROM workspace.exam_xaed8f.tickets
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_xaed8f.ticket_themes (theme STRING, ticket_count LONG, example_ticket_id LONG)
